gnomcp.description: Official Gno MCP server (gnoverse/gno-mcp). Stdio transport, no arguments: the built-in local, testnet, and mainnet profiles ship with the server. Install the binary first, per the upstream README at the pinned commit in agent/README.md, then restart the MCP client so it loads the server.

local.note: Local gnodev chain. Built-in gnomcp profile name: local.

mainnet.note: Read-only in gnomcp by construction. Never sign writes on mainnet.

testnet.note: Onyx public testnet. Built-in gnomcp profile name: testnet. Needs a funded key; the faucet needs a captcha, a browser step.

key.name: realmcheck-dev
key.note: Key reference by NAME ONLY. Never put a private key or mnemonic in this file, in the repo, or in chat. The key lives in the local gnokey home.

submitGas.note: Applies to the gnokey fallback path. The gnomcp gno_call tool takes no gas arguments in this version; the server sizes the transaction, so always read gas used back from the call result.
